name: ballerina/data.xmldata
description: The Ballerina XML Data Library is a comprehensive toolkit designed to facilitate the handling and manipulation of XML data within Ballerina applications. It streamlines the process of converting XML data to native Ballerina data types, enabling developers to work with XML content seamlessly and efficiently.

typeDefs.name: JsonOptions
typeDefs.description: Provides configurations for converting JSON to XML.

fields.description: The prefix of JSON elements' key which is to be treated as an attribute in the XML representation

fields.name: arrayEntryTag

fields.name: rootTag
fields.description:
The name of the root element of the XML that will be created. If its value is (), and the converted XML
is not in the valid format, it will create a root tag as `root`

fields.description: field name for the text field

fields.name: userAttributePrefix
fields.description: The prefix of JSON elements' key which used by the user to distinguish the attribute fields

functions.name: toXml
functions.description:
Converts a `Map` or `Record` representation to its XML representation.
Additionally, when converting from a record, the `xmldata:Namespace`, `xmldata:Name`, and `xmldata:Attribute`
annotations can be used to add `namespaces`, `name of elements`, and `attributes` to XML representation.

parameters.name: mapValue
parameters.description: The `Map` or `Record` representation source to be converted to XML

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Options to be used for filtering in the projection

return.description:
XML representation of the given source if the source is
successfully converted or else an `xmldata:Error`

functions.name: fromJson
functions.description: Converts a JSON object to an XML representation.

parameters.name: jsonValue
parameters.description: The JSON source to be converted to XML

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The `xmldata:JsonOptions` record for JSON to XML conversion properties

return.description: XML representation of the given JSON if the JSON is successfully converted or else an `xmldata:Error`.

functions.name: validate
functions.description:
Validates an XML document against an XML schema.

The schema can either be a file path to the `.xsd` file or a Ballerina record type that represents
the schema defined by the XSD. The function checks if the XML value conforms to the specified schema.

parameters.name: xmlValue
parameters.description: The XML document that needs to be validated against the schema.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description:
A string representing the file path to the `.xsd` file or a
Ballerina record type representing the schema defined by the XSD.

return.description: Returns `()` if the XML value is valid according to the schema, otherwise returns `Error`.

functions.name: transform
functions.description: Transforms the XML value using the XPath query and projects the result to the specified type.

parameters.name: xmlValue
parameters.description: The XML value to be transformed

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The XPath query to be used for transformation

parameters.name: td
parameters.description: The type to which the result of the XPath query should be projected

return.description:
On success, returns the projected value, if either query is invalid or result of query can't be projected
to the specified type, returns an `Error` value
